mapper.sql: t.id, t.farmer_id, t.title, t.content, t.category_id, t.is_pinned, t.view_count, t.reply_count, t.created_at, t.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT , u.name AS farmer_name, c.name AS category_name FROM forum_topics t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON t.farmer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN forum_categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_topics (farmer_id, title, content, category_id, is_pinned, view_count, reply_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{farmerId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{categoryId}, #{isPinned}, 0, 0, GETDATE(), GETDATE())
